|game_text=Once per game, may take into hand a prison from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Use 1 Force to take into hand a non-droid assassin or slaver of ability < 5 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle involving an assassin, each of opponent's battle destiny draws is -1. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to modify the power of a starship piloted by your alien.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Sonic Bombardment (V) (Virtual Block 8)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-p3-17-Sonic_Bombardment-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-sonicbombardment-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-17-Sonic_Bombardment.png]]) show the original text (see [[Sonic Bombardment (V) (Virtual Block 8)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Sonic Bombardment (V) (Virtual Block 8)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Once per game ▲ a prison. OR Use 1 Force to ▲ a non-droid assassin (or slaver) of ability < 5. OR During battle involving an assassin, opponent's battle destiny draws are -1. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to modify the power of a starfighter piloted by your alien.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-sonicbombardment-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p3-17-Sonic_Bombardment.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 39) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) wrote the ▲ out (“may take into hand … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”), changed “(or slaver)” to “or slaver”, “opponent's battle destiny draws are -1” to “each of opponent's battle destiny draws is -1” and “starfighter” to “starship”<ref name="cl-1281_17-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “Once per game, may take into hand a prison from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Use 1 Force to take into hand a non-droid assassin or slaver of ability < 5 from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During battle involving an assassin, each of opponent's battle destiny draws is -1. OR Cancel opponent's attempt to modify the power of a starship piloted by your alien.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-sonicbombardment-pre.gif]], undated) prints this text with a comma after “Once per game”, a punctuation-only difference. No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-p3-17-Sonic_Bombardment-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
